description: This Java class 'DefaultEdgeInstallInstructionsService' provides installation instructions for edge devices, supporting Docker and Linux (Ubuntu/CentOS), with methods to generate instructions based on the environment and configuration.

classes.name: DefaultEdgeInstallInstructionsService
classes.description: Service class providing edge installation instructions, supporting Docker and Linux environments, with configuration properties for RPC port and SSL.

methods.name: getInstallInstructions
methods.description: Returns installation instructions based on the specified method (docker, ubuntu, centos).

methods.name: getDockerInstallInstructions
methods.description: Generates Docker installation instructions, customizing placeholders based on the request's server name.

methods.name: getLinuxInstallInstructions
methods.description: Generates Linux (Ubuntu/CentOS) installation instructions, replacing placeholders with edge and request data.

methods.name: replacePlaceholders
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in instruction templates with actual edge and configuration data.

methods.name: getBaseDirName
methods.description: Returns the base directory name for installation scripts ('install').
